Two reasons, one inherited and one this unit sharpens. Inherited: invariant 5.3 forces the promote verb to be deployed to ~/.claude/local/ outside every release, so its deployed copy's version is recorded nowhere and a hand-patch would survive a refresh undetected. Sharpened: settings.json is now permanently a live file that no release reproduces, removed on both branches of buildRelease (scripts/config/release.mjs:35-38 and :67-68) and again at scripts/config/promote.mjs:41-42, which is decision 0270's intent but is exactly M6's hand-patched-deployed-file shape - a refresh cannot regenerate it from committed source at a recorded sha. Corroborating evidence on this machine: .claude/hooks/tests/protect-claude-config.test.mjs:194 fails because ~/.claude/settings.json is a real 0600 file rather than a symlink out of the home tree, while that test's PROBE_FILES list at :16 still names settings.json.

This row previously cleared the python spawn on the grounds that PYTHON_PARSE_PROGRAM is a module constant with nothing interpolated from the hook file. That reasoning was falsified: the risk was never the program text, it was the sys.path entry `-c` implies. On the parent commit b365b76, `python3 -c` inherited the cwd of the Claude Code process, which put that directory first on sys.path, so a repository holding a root-level ast.py had that file EXECUTED during validation, and because the shadow parse() returned instead of raising, the checker exited 0 and the whole python gate passed - measured end to end, the candidate carrying a syntactically broken python hook was ACCEPTED with zero failure rows and the shadow module's marker file was written. The spawn is now contained rather than argued about: python3 runs with -I (scripts/config/validate.mjs:50), which drops the working directory from sys.path and implies -E and -s; every checker runs with shell:false, an explicitly constructed PATH-only environment (checkerEnvironment at :304-307), a freshly created empty working directory (openSandbox at :309-315, passed as cwd at :337), a 15s timeout and a 256KiB output cap (:340-341, values at :56-57); and the command is re-checked against the frozen CHECKER_COMMANDS set at :329-334 before spawnSync is reached at :335. Re-probed at HEAD: the shadow ast.py is not executed and the broken hook is rejected. No network-named command is invoked and no argument is credential-shaped, so G5's escalation condition is not reached.
